name: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone
overview: Jenna Steele loved Noah Finch for a decade--until she caught him crossing the line with comatose Lucy Steele. She ends the engagement and turns to Caleb Shaw, the boy she once protected. Framed and humiliated by Noah and Lucy, Jenna's career is destroyed. But Caleb steps in to help. Now, with him by her side, she rises from the ashes and they're ready to make everyone pay.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
